what: scripts/research/research_disposition.py::CORPORA holds exactly e35, m20 and gld_compat (read 2026-09-22). comms/strategy_evidence -- the store the four-clause promotion bar actually reads -- is not among them, so a research unit whose n comes from n_trades_oos cannot ground its power.feasibility on the corpus and must declare source: none. Four of the ten units written this session do exactly that (RQ-20260922-003/004/007/009). The alternative, grounding on e35, would launder a bracket-sweep OOS boundary count as a harness_timefolds count -- the substitution the feasibility check exists to catch.
